title: tui.json
description: Settings used only by ask-tui. Layered like ask.json.

theme.description: Starting theme: ask, a bundled theme such as dracula, or a custom themes/<name>.json (also ASK_THEME, --theme).

contextWindow.description: The model's context capacity in tokens (also ASK_CONTEXT_WINDOW, --context-window). When set, the oldest history is dropped so each request fits.

mouse.description: Use mouse selection and scrolling in the TUI (--no-mouse sets false). Default true.
